knobs.note: Read by bin/claude-auth-check.sh as ${AUTH_CHECK_LIB:-}. Registered by BH-1165 so it is visible; NOT settable from the control plane — it is a command, a host, a path, an identity or a test seam a root lane uses, so only env/global.env on the box moves it; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.

Empty by default since BH-1510.2: the model is a database row, model_routes role 'auth.fallback', read through bin/claude-auth-check.sh (resolved on the hub, written into the probe; a box env still wins there). Set this only to override that row on this box/lane; no reviewed min/max, nothing is clamped.

Read by bin/claude-auth-check.sh (ld_mark in bin/lib/lane-down.sh, and auth_lane_row for lane claude <box>) as ${LANE_DOWN_TTL_S:-7200}: seconds a fleet `lane` row (bin/lib/fleet-cooldown.sh) stays live after a mark; every mark refreshes it; a non-numeric or 0 value falls back to 7200. Registered by BH-2359, the change that introduced the read; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.

0 makes this lane call no model at all. bin/lib/llm-gate.sh refuses BEFORE the vendor call and writes a zero-cost row_source=refused row, so the stop is visible in the ledger rather than being a lane that went quiet.

Comma/space list of the ONLY ladder rungs this lane may reach. Empty is every rung, i.e. today's ladder unchanged. A rung outside the list is refused before the call, so a cliff or a failure on the standing lane cannot descend into one that costs ~100x (#1141, the $793 descent).

Dollars this lane may spend in the current UTC day, summed from D1 cost_rows through GET /api/metrics/llm-spend — never from the box's own logs/cost.csv. A second, project-scoped ceiling is the lane.<id>.<project>.llm_usd_cap_day row, which is read only when somebody wrote it.
